latestVersion.changelog:
video-trimmer-editor v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Upload video clips and trim/edit via simple text instructions.
- Automated cloud backend handles trimming, editing, and 1080p exports in 30–60 seconds per clip.
- No timeline interface or export settings required; just describe the edit you want.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more; max file size 500MB.
- 100 free credits for new users, automatic anonymous onboarding.
